finding.fix: Use a portable alternative: SCRIPT_REALPATH="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)/$(basename "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" or install coreutils as a dependency and document it.
